He found his little cave again, but he had no longer peace of mind.
His friend’s offers had robbed him of it.

ja: たされていたのは、ヘラクレスのような
u.src: He found himself, not between vice and virtue, like Hercules, but between mediocrity coupled with an assured prosperity, and all the heroic dreams of his youth.

ja: った。そして、このことへの
u.src: “So I have not got real determination after all,” he said to himself, and it was his doubt on this score which pained him the most.

ja: われてしまうのではないかと、
u.src: “I am not of the stuff of which great men are made, because I fear that eight years spent in earning a livelihood will deprive me of that sublime energy which inspires the accomplishment of extraordinary feats.”
